summary: Decoded OpenSpool tags fail validation when saved locally because OpenSpool NDEF payloads lack a color name field and decoded temperatures are ignored.
claim: Decoded OpenSpool tags fail validation when saved locally because OpenSpool NDEF payloads lack a color name field and decoded temperatures are ignored.

evidence.source: In MainViewModel.kt, decodedSeed() maps the decoded tag values into CustomSeed with color set to "" and omits min_temp, max_temp, bed_min_temp, and bed_max_temp. When saveCustom() is invoked, validateRecord() throws a ValidationException("Brand, material, product, and color are required").

suggested_remediation: Modify decodedSeed() to extract min_temp, max_temp, bed_min_temp, and bed_max_temp from the decoded JsonValue map, provide a sensible default or derived color name when converting NDEF payloads, and update CustomDialog to expose temperature editing.
suggested_validation: Scan an OpenSpool tag containing temperature ranges, select 'Edit as a local record', and save the record without manual intervention; confirm that the local record saves successfully and retains the decoded temperatures.
